title: Cartoons of Bernard Partridge
content: Churchill, Roosevelt, and Stalin check up on the state of the world.Bernard Partridge(English, 1861-1945) was a book illustrator and a cartoonist for the humor magazinePunch.His illustrations were admired by Adolph Menzel. Many of his cartoons dealt with themes of war and peace during the era of the Great Wars.-----Bernard Partridge on Wikipedia.
